Proposition
[Dimension of Tangent Spaces on a Manifold with Boundary]

↗ lem:3-11 ↗ prop:3-6 ↗ prop:3-9

1. ch3:3.12If $M$ is a smooth $n$-manifold with boundary, then $\dim T_pM=n$ for every $p\in M$.

Proof

\sketch At an interior point, apply Proposition 4 to the open submanifold $\operatorname {Int}M$. At a boundary point, a boundary chart $\varphi :U\to \widehat U\subseteq \mathbb {H}^n$, Propositions 2 and 4, and Lemma 4 give

\[ T_pM\cong T_pU\cong T_{\varphi (p)}\widehat U \cong T_{\varphi (p)}\mathbb {H}^n \cong T_{\varphi (p)}\mathbb {R}^n. \]

□
